claim: Deadlock states are exactly the total dominating sets of the carrier line graph.
evidence: tests/test_domination.py. Hand sets: three-edge chain 3, three-edge branch and triangle 4, four-cycle 9, two disjoint edges 0, two adjacent edges 1. Atlas-004 deadlock counts for the four incident-prohibit templates agree. The chain has more recurrent classes than deadlocks.
